item.description: The next_token function has incomplete implementation for handling certain token types, particularly for dictionary parsing and incomplete tokens. The function returns None for incomplete tokens but doesn't properly handle cases where tokens are incomplete at the end of a string or where nested structures aren't correctly parsed.
item.contract: Fix the next_token function to properly handle dictionary parsing with nested structures, incomplete tokens, and ensure that it correctly identifies and returns token types for all supported PDF syntax elements including dictionaries, arrays, names, and values.

item.description: The parse_obj function has issues with parsing nested dictionaries and handling various data types properly. It doesn't correctly process nested structures and has problems with reference handling in arrays and dictionaries.
item.contract: Improve the parse_obj function to correctly handle nested dictionaries, properly parse complex data structures like nested dictionaries and arrays, and correctly convert reference values (e.g., 6 0 R) to complex numbers (6j).

item.description: The xref table parsing function has indexing issues that cause IndexError when accessing table elements. The function does not properly validate bounds before accessing elements in the xref table.
item.contract: Fix the parse_xref_table function to properly validate indices before accessing elements in the xref table to prevent IndexError exceptions when accessing table elements.

item.description: The SimpleFile and Updating classes have setup errors due to IndexError when accessing list elements. These classes rely on accessing elements in index/cache lists that may not be properly initialized or have insufficient elements.
item.contract: Fix the SimpleFile and Updating classes to properly initialize and access index/cache elements to prevent IndexError exceptions during setup phases.

item.description: The decode_stream function contains placeholder implementations for various stream filters (LZWDecode, ASCIIHexDecode, etc.) that are not implemented. These filters are essential for proper PDF stream decoding.
item.contract: Implement the missing stream filter decoding functions in the decode_stream function for LZWDecode, ASCIIHexDecode, ASCII85Decode, RunLengthDecode, CCITTFaxDecode, JBIG2Decode, DCTDecode, and JPXDecode to properly decode PDF streams.
item.acceptance: Future implementation of core PDF syntax parsing components in pdfsyntax/objects.py
